parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel attached to the base of the cart, used for rolling movement.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the cart’s load and allows smooth rolling motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward movement.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel located at one corner of the cart base.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates freely to facilitate cart movement.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel forming part of the four-wheel support system.
parts.Functional_description: Helps distribute load evenly and ensures smooth motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axis to allow directional movement.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel located at the rear of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: Provides mobility and stability to the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates to enable cart movement in multiple directions.

parts.name: Yoke (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A steel yoke connecting the wheel to the base frame.
parts.Functional_description: Holds the wheel assembly and allows it to swivel.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around a vertical axis to enable steering.

parts.name: Yoke (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A steel yoke component supporting one of the wheels.
parts.Functional_description: Connects the wheel to the base and allows pivoting.

parts.name: Yoke (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A steel yoke part of the wheel assembly.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural connection between wheel and base.

parts.name: Yoke (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A steel yoke supporting a wheel at the corner of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: Holds the wheel and allows it to swivel for maneuverability.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around a vertical axis for directional control.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main steel frame and platform of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the load and provides a handle for pushing or pulling.
parts.Movement_description: Remains stationary relative to the wheels; transmits force from handle to wheels.
